description: Anthropic Messages streaming places prompt-side usage on message_start and the cumulative output count on the final message_delta. A gateway that reads only message_delta drops the input bucket. Transcripts are synthetic and minimal; they are not captured customer traffic. Pins roy-tong/AgentMeasure#24 (precedent: atopos31/llmio#71, modelbus/one-api-pro#13).
claim_boundary: synthetic fixture, not a production observation and not an endorsement of any gateway

vectors.name: Anthropic prompt usage on message_start
vectors.description: Prompt-side buckets (input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens) are observed on message_start.message.usage. The final message_delta.usage.output_tokens is the cumulative output count and is not added to the small output_tokens that message_start also carries.
vectors.principle: A reader that only inspects message_delta cannot see prompt-side usage when the provider puts those buckets only on message_start. Missing input is a failed check, never a zero.

vectors.description: usage on message_start and the final message_delta → PASS
same stream, but usage exists only on message_delta → FAIL

expect.failure_reason: anthropic_message_start_input_bucket: message_start has no input_tokens, and message_delta usage carries only output_tokens. The prompt-side input bucket is missing; a gateway that reads only message_delta drops it.
